Subsection.title: Description
Subsection.Paragraph: The clips data section holds all audio data for clips present in the audio map.

Informally, the audio data for each clip is stored in the order specified by the clip descriptions. For the sake of not formalizing every possible type of audio data, this specification treats the audio data as opaque reserved space:

Subsection.title: Cardinality
Subsection.Paragraph: A clips data section must appear in a aurantium audio map file exactly once.
